відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The coat, boots, bag and earrings finish the outfit around the sweater and trousers, so the whole look stays calm and tidy for the office. It works because the coat and the sweater both suit frost on your walk, and the coat's level fits an office day. The straight line of the coat gives one clean vertical, and the trousers narrowing toward the ankle anchor it, so the outfit does not turn into a shapeless volume.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wear the sweater under the coat and keep the coat buttoned on the walk in the frost. Unbutton it once you are inside.\",\"Let the trousers hem sit right at the top of the ankle boots with no gap, so the line of your leg stays unbroken.\",\"Keep the earrings as the only piece of jewelry, so the look stays tidy for the office.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#60·37\",\"what\":\"coat\"},{\"n\":\"#5·30\",\"what\":\"sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#296·29\",\"what\":\"trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#356·15\",\"what\":\"ankle boots\"},{\"n\":\"#79·45\",\"what\":\"bag\"},{\"n\":\"#239·14\",\"what\":\"earrings\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#60·37\",\"text\":\"The coat suits an office day, and its wool is made for frost, which is why it leads the outfit for your walk. I chose it on purpose even though it sits a touch more casual than the office usually asks: warmth comes first here.\"},{\"n\":\"#5·30\",\"text\":\"The sweater suits the office and keeps you warm in the frost. I chose it on purpose, even though it reads a little softer than a strict office level, because it works well under the coat.\"},{\"n\":\"#296·29\",\"text\":\"The trousers fit the office. I chose them on purpose, even though they sit slightly below the usual office level, because they keep the line of the outfit simple and tidy.\"},{\"n\":\"#356·15\",\"text\":\"The ankle boots fit the office level. I chose them on purpose, even though they sit slightly below it and their high cut at the ankle can interrupt the leg line. Keeping the trousers hem right at their top solves that.\"},{\"n\":\"#79·45\",\"text\":\"The bag is made from a material that holds up well in frost, so it is practical for your walk to the office.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":14738,"output_tokens":2039},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
